tools.name: project_map
tools.description: Get a compressed map of the project: directory tree, key files, recent changes, language stats. Use "focus" to zoom into a subdirectory.

include_stats.description: Include line count stats per language

tools.name: file_context
tools.description: Get a compressed summary of a file: exports, functions, classes, types, interfaces. Saves tokens vs reading the full file.

file_path.description: File path (relative to project root or absolute)

detail.description: outline: signatures only; summary: signatures + docstrings

tools.name: lint_check
tools.description: Run linter and/or type-checker on files. Auto-detects language and tools. Defaults to checking only changed files.

files.description: Specific files to check (relative to project root)

scope.description: Which files: changed (git diff), staged (git diff --cached), all

fix.description: Auto-fix where possible (only for linter, not type-checker)

tools.name: run_tests
tools.description: Run tests. Supports smart selection: only run tests related to recently changed files. Returns pass/fail status and failure details.

mode.description: related: find tests for changed files; file: run specific test files; all: run entire suite

files_changed.description: Source files that were modified (for "related" mode). Auto-detected from git diff if omitted.

test_files.description: Specific test files to run (for "file" mode)

grep.description: Filter: only run tests matching this pattern (supported by most runners)

tools.name: dep_graph
tools.description: Get import/dependency graph for a file: what it imports and what imports it. Helps understand impact of changes.

file_path.description: File to analyze (relative to project root)

direction.description: Which direction: imports (what this file uses), imported_by (who uses this file), both

depth.description: Traversal depth for imports (1 = direct only, 2 = includes transitive)

tools.name: quality_report
tools.description: Generate quality metrics for recent changes: diff stats, file breakdown, lint summary, commit info. Helps assess the impact and quality of work done.

since.description: Git ref to compare against: HEAD~1, HEAD~5, a commit hash, a branch name

include_lint.description: Run lint on changed files and include error count

tools.name: session_sync
tools.description: Sync local context with llmapi.pro proxy layer: push project info, pull cross-session observations, check sync status.

action.description: push: send local data to proxy; pull: get data from proxy; status: check connectivity

data_type.description: What to sync. pull: observations | flywheel_rules. push: project_info | quality | quality_metrics.
